title: Adjunction field for the integral tensor presentation
statement: For the closed structure S and its symmetric braiding β, there is an adjunction in the tensor parameter for every derived object K, with left functor S.tensor curried at K and right functor the recorded derived internal Hom curried at op K.

proof.text: Use the generic closed symmetric monoidal derived structure and transport its right-tensor adjunction across the symmetric braiding to obtain the required left-tensor adjunction.

mathlib_searches.results: No exact proved project declaration; generic closed symmetric monoidal theorem supplies the input structure.
